text: Do you play to protect the group rather than to deceive it?
Would you rather start the game already holding a clue?
Are you happy to be woken up every single night?
Would you trade a steady trickle of information for one big moment?
Are you quietly not what everyone thinks you are?
Do numbers tell you more than names do?
Do you like to point at someone and see what happens?
Would you rather survive the game than understand it?
Could someone else's death be the best thing that happens to you?
Do you enjoy shaping the game before anyone has said a word?
Would you end your own life if it meant your team would win?
Do you want to see everyone's cards, not just a few?
Could your own execution decide the whole game?
Are you happiest following someone else's lead?
Would you rather get a clear yes-or-no than a vague hint?
Would you rather stay out of the spotlight?
Do you want to learn exactly who someone is?
Do you go looking for evil instead of waiting for it to find you?
Do people tend to rally around you?
Is keeping someone else safe more satisfying than catching a liar?
Could you enjoy a game where your power is more of a burden?
Do you like making other people's information wrong?
Do you like being underestimated?
Are you patient enough to wait for exactly the right moment?
Are the odd ones out more interesting to you than the usual suspects?
